item.description: Meneia #4789 was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Burning Lake of Eridanus's freedom). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.title: The seer Agathstratos #1400 looked at Chrysdoros #5112's house in the Field of Ares and cr
item.description: The seer Agathstratos #1400 looked at Chrysdoros #5112's house in the Field of Ares and cried out: the walls drip blood, the porch is full of ghosts going down to the dark, the sun has perished from heaven. The household laughed with jaws not their own.

item.title: The story has changed in the telling. In the Field of Ares they now say: "They say 55 rose
item.description: The story has changed in the telling. In the Field of Ares they now say: "They say 55 rose up in Pagasae & the Agora and the Reapers ran. Some already call the dead a martyr. The augurs say it was foretold."
